headline: Binance Allocates $6.34 Billion to Cover Record Crypto Hack Losses
summary: Binance has reserved its own funds to cover a $6.3 billion crypto hack, which includes freezing approximately $3 billion in stolen assets.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and security incidents involving substantial funds can impact market confidence and regulatory scrutiny across the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The exchange faces a massive financial outflow and reserve allocation to cover the hack losses.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reserving $6.34 billion in internal funds to cover stolen assets directly impacts the exchange's capital reserves and raises concerns about platform security.
